author: /root/compiler_research
scope: Complete source review of preparation, compiler-free native timing, freeze and failure checks, aggregation and CLI; independent execution of synthetic controls.
checks: All five base sources are checked against the original frozen corpus before copying; fixed longer inputs and independent expected outputs are frozen before build.
Build, empty-input startup diagnostic and long-input preflight are distinct from formal native timing; no startup subtraction occurs.
Measure executes only frozen native programs with fixed single-CPU affinity, captures full process wall and wait4 CPU, and preserves timeout outputs.
Plan, executable, input and raw logs are checked; missing rows, hash drift or unsuccessful behavior suppress all aggregate scores.
Paired arm means, across-block medians and weighted absolute costs are applied in the declared order; whole blocks are jointly resampled.
Summary reports every case, startup fraction and executable size; it does not drop regressions.
actual_data_review: CP04 raw runtime data and arithmetic were separately audited by /root/backend_audit, who did not author this tool. See cp04/independent-runtime-arithmetic.json.
limits: Control tests are not compiler performance samples.
Five-case exploratory runtime quality does not establish full product acceptance.
